treatment: Keep the authored dark pupil or lid, add an in-palette upper lid, one opposite-gaze sclera pixel, and a restrained warm lower edge only where the source pixels allow it. Exact edits are listed per frame. Closed, obscured, motion-compressed, and already-distinct eye frames are preserved.
